projects.title: File-Format Utility Test Coverage
bullets: Wrote unit tests for utility functions using Python and pytest in a supervised undergraduate team course project on small open-source file-format libraries.
Measured branch coverage and documented test failures and fixes for the public file-format utilities studied in the course project.

projects.title: Data-Cleaning Library Test Coverage
bullets: Wrote unit tests for utility functions using Python and pytest in a supervised graduate team course project on small open-source data-cleaning libraries.
Reproduced reported software defects and measured branch coverage for the public data-cleaning libraries studied in the course project.

research.title: Numerical Utility Test Coverage
bullets: Wrote unit tests for utility functions using Python and pytest as a supervised student research assistant studying small open-source numerical utility libraries.
Measured branch coverage and documented test failures and fixes for public numerical utility libraries within supervised faculty research.
